acceptance_criteria: description serializes as null when None. All tests pass.
close_reason: Removed skip_serializing_if from AddressBook.description; added test confirming null serialization; 22+1 tests pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Remove skip_serializing_if from AddressBook.description. Spec §2 and §4.1 example show "description": null always present.

**Algorithm:**
1. In addressbook.rs, change description field: remove skip_serializing_if, keep #[serde(default)].
2. Add test address_book_description_null_serializes: AddressBook with description: None → serialized JSON contains "description":null. Oracle: spec §4.1 both example address books have "description": null.
3. Verify address_book_round_trip_with_description still passes (Some case unaffected).
4. Run cargo test -p jmap-contacts-types.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Serializing with description: None produces "description":null in JSON.
- cargo test -p jmap-contacts-types exits 0. Clippy clean.
title: Fix AddressBook.description serializes as null not absent
